title: Singleton Fourier coefficients and majority influence
statement: Let $n$ be a natural number and let $f$ be any Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube. The sum, over coordinates $i$, of the absolute values of the singleton Fourier coefficients of the real-valued version of $f$ is at most the total influence of the majority function on the same cube.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
